name: ORVEL
source:
A story following three wannabe writer sisters that are trying to pitch their book to a curmudgeon merchant. Three different stories, three authors, which one will be picked?

[From [url=https://cedesdcc.itch.io/orvel]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
讲述了三个想成为作家的姐妹试图向一位脾气暴躁的商人推销她们的书的故事。三个不同的故事，三个作者，会选择哪一个呢？

[来自[url=https://cedesdcc.itch.io/orvel]itch.io[/url]]
